messages:
Elliot Park: Morning  MapleAI wants a 10-seat preview focused on knowledge-base ingestion + retrieval quality. They asked for a concierge setup and a simple SLA for uptime and latency during the pilot.
Lucia (MapleAI): Hi all  we can do Wed kickoff. Priority items: ingestion pipeline, telemetry for retrieval freshness, and an SLA note we can include for the team.
Elliot Park: @Tara can you own concierge onboarding (ingest runbook + sample scripts)? Also add a short checklist for doc redaction.
Tara Nguyen: Yep. I'll prepare an ingestion runbook and a one-click script that hits our /ingest endpoint. Will include redaction examples and a quick sanity-check query.
Gabe Moreno: I'll handle telemetry and the dashboard. Need these metrics: documents ingested, avg retrieval precision (sampled), p95 retrieval lat, and tokens used.
onboard-bot: Pilot created  docs: Elliot Park, infra: Gabe Moreno, enablement: Tara Nguyen, legal: intake-team.
Gabe Moreno: Minimal telemetry example I'll ask MapleAI to send:
```
POST https://telemetry.redwood.ai/v1/ingest_events
Authorization: Bearer <KEY>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "customer":"mapleai",
  "job_id":"ingest_2026_03",
  "documents":1200,
  "avg_fetch_ms":85,
  "sample_precision":0.87
}
```
Tara Nguyen: For the concierge script I'll provide a small docker-compose and a `maple-ingest.sh` wrapper. Also include a dry-run mode.
Elliot Park: SLA ask: they're okay with 'best-effort' but want an explicit pilot latency SLO: p95 retrieval < 300ms. If we miss it 3x in a week, we commit to a joint postmortem and mitigation.
Gabe Moreno: I'll add an alert `maple_preview_high_retrieval_latency` (p95 > 300ms for 15m) and an incident playbook.
Lucia (MapleAI): Also want cost projection and an example regression report format we can share with their CTO.
Tara Nguyen: Cost proj: baseline (current expected): 50k tokens/day across team; scaled: 150k tokens/day. I'll add charts for both and a simple CSV export.
Elliot Park: Renewal risk: they said renewal depends on "search quality" after 14 days. If sampled precision < 0.7 at day 10, we escalate to solutions engineering and offer an extra concierge week.
Gabe Moreno: I'll bake sampled precision into the health score and add a daily export. Also will surface examples of low-precision queries for debugging (sanitized).
Elliot Park: Enablement cadence: Day 0 kickoff + ingest run, Day 2 check-in (quality sampling), Day 7 deep-dive (power users), Day 12 renewal prep. Tara will run the Day 7 workshop.
Lucia (MapleAI): That sounds good. We'll send SAML metadata and a sample dataset (anonymized) before Tue EOD.
Tara Nguyen: Action items: Tara  ingestion runbook + docker script by Mon EOD. Gabe  dashboard + alerts by Mon EOD. Elliot  send kickoff invite for Wed 1pm PT and attach pilot success criteria.
Elliot Park: Saving thread as the source of truth for MapleAI preview concierge + SLA discussion. Will update with links to runbook and dashboard. :pushpin:
